description: Minimal contract set exercising the frozen XI v1 substrate. Used by the determinism probe in the freeze receipt and by the CLI self-check.

contracts.title: Artifact is present and non-empty
contracts.pass_condition: the submitted artifact is not null, empty string, empty array, or empty object

contracts.title: Artifact carries its declared keys
contracts.input_contract: the whole submitted artifact as an object
contracts.pass_condition: the artifact is an object carrying every key in config.keys

contracts.title: Payload size is measurable and routine
contracts.pass_condition: canonical payload size is measurable and at or below config.max_bytes
